title: FoxCoin
description: FoxCoin simple mod that adds a selection of 6 coins to minecraft from simple copper to netherite, made to have fun with simple economics no hard system in-place thats up to the player and server. Good luck :D
body:
FoxCoin brings simple economics to minecraft in the form of valuable coins. Copper, Silver, RoseGold, Gold, Platinum, and Netherite coins with plans on expanding the uses of the 3 new metals at a later date with brand new sets of tools and armor and more. 

This is my first ever mod and was made for a server in mind but would love to see what other people do with it. 

Also for the moment the recipe for the coins is the ingot inside of the stonecutter itself. Till and if I make a custom block for the recipe that is where it will be.
